target_problem: comparison-free range avoidance inside large positive-surplus components after deterministic support/truth-table reductions
conditional_implication: V97 gives an unconditional deterministic O(2^lambda poly(N)) avoider, where lambda is the residual input count after a fixed safe peeling calculus on the best positive-surplus component. This strictly dominates the V96 component-size parameter rho because lambda<=rho, and an explicit nonmonotone ternary family has rho=N but lambda=ceil(log2 N). The result does not extend to arbitrary large irreducible kernels and therefore does not trigger a published lower-bound transfer.
frontier_reason: The result enlarges the deterministic comparison-free tractable regime but remains parameterized; no all-instance polynomial or FP^NP algorithm is obtained.

bridge_lemmas.name: inessential support coordinates can be removed exactly in constant local work
deleting a degree-one input together with its unique output preserves liftability of every reduced missing word
an essential unary output can be fixed to target zero, forcing its unique input value and allowing safe substitution
positive surplus survives every nonterminating peeling step
enumerating the residual lambda-input kernel yields an avoided output in O(2^lambda poly(N))
lambda(C)<=rho(C) for the V96 positive-component parameter
there is a connected nonmonotone ternary stretch-one family with rho=N and lambda=ceil(log2 N)
every irreducible large peeling kernel admits polynomial-time range avoidance
the Huang-Li-Zhong worst-case exponent is improved

current_gap: After safe peeling, the remaining hard regime has a positive-surplus kernel with superlogarithmically many inputs, no input of degree at most one, and no constant or essential-unary output. The promising next restriction is a 3-uniform linear/nonmonotone kernel where current Turan theory guarantees structural cycles but the gate-label surjectivity obstruction is not yet classified.
result_obtained: A deterministic support/truth-table peeling calculus and an O(2^lambda poly(N)) comparison-free avoider that strictly dominates V96's O(2^rho poly(N)) parameter on an explicit nonmonotone ternary family.
closed_route: treating the raw size of the smallest positive-surplus connected component as the final structural parameter
surviving_route: irreducible large-kernel extraction, especially Turan loose-X certificates with general ternary gate labels or another local nonsurjectivity certificate
stop_rule: Do not spend V98 only adding more leaf-style reductions. Promotion requires a polynomial constructor on a genuinely large irreducible kernel class, a symbolic gate-label theorem for a Turan certificate, or a formal obstruction showing why the monotone loose-X method cannot extend to a specified nonmonotone gate class.
external_validation_target: Kuntewar-Sarma APPROX/RANDOM 2025 Turan-type range avoidance; Huang-Li-Zhong ITCS 2026 all-instance benchmark; external prior-art review of the peeling-kernel parameter
